notes.md: - **Rashtriya Poshan Maah:** observed every **September** by the **Ministry of Women and Child Development** under **Poshan Abhiyaan** (launched **8 March 2018**, Jhunjhunu). The **8th** Poshan Maah was launched by PM Modi on **17 September 2025**.
- **Booker Prize 2025:** won by **'Flesh'** by Hungarian-British writer **David Szalay** (announced **10 November 2025**, London); Kiran Desai's book was on the shortlist.
- **IOC President:** **Kirsty Coventry** (**Zimbabwe**) took office on **23 June 2025**, succeeding **Thomas Bach** – the **first woman** and **first African** to head the IOC.
- **NCW Chairperson:** **Vijaya Kishore Rahatkar** – appointed **October 2024** under **Section 3 of the NCW Act, 1990** (3 years or age 65); succeeded **Rekha Sharma**.
